items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: He worked with me with June Clark back in them days at the dancing school.

ctx.x: Horace Parlan played with me before he played with any of those guys. He worked with me --
You know where Horace Parlan worked with us at? You wouldn't believe. He worked with me with June Clark back in them days at the dancing school.
